characters.name: Miho
characters.personality: Once the group's sunshine. Now hollow. Uses excessive energy to hide the void inside. Fast talker who never pauses anymore - because silence hurts.
characters.background: Ex-vocalist. Contract terminated after 'attitude problems.' Truth: she refused to lose weight further. Now bounces between questionable gigs, terrified of being 'useless' again.

traits.darkSecret: Skips meals when stressed. Says it's intentional.
traits.redemptionPath: Learn she has value beyond performance

characters.name: Sohee
characters.personality: Emotionally detached. Speaks in short, flat sentences. Seen as cold - but she was the one who watched everything fall apart and couldn't stop it.
characters.background: Ex-visual. The company kept her on thin photos because she 'photographed well even when dying inside.' She was there when the other members broke. She did nothing.

traits.darkSecret: Hasn't cried in two years. Can't remember how.
traits.redemptionPath: Confront what she witnessed, learn to feel again

characters.name: Sujin
characters.personality: Polite to the point of self-erasure. Says 'it's fine' to everything. Was always the one who tried to keep peace - even when it meant being used.
characters.background: Ex-lead dancer. Contract sold to another company without her consent. That company turned out to be a front. She's still technically owned by people who want her to do 'private performances.'

traits.darkSecret: Technically still under contract. Can't legally work elsewhere.
traits.redemptionPath: Claim her own voice, break the contract that binds her

characters.name: Hyunju
characters.personality: Hyperactive. Volunteers for everything. Says she's 'totally fine' while clearly running from something. Perfectionism became self-punishment.
characters.background: Ex-main dancer. Developed chronic pain from overtraining. Company dropped her the moment she couldn't perform at 100%. Now works three jobs, none legal, all exhausting.

traits.darkSecret: Hides injuries. Can't afford to stop moving.
traits.redemptionPath: Rest is not failure. She deserves to take up space.

characters.name: Yuseong
characters.personality: Charming predator. Appears helpful, offers 'solutions' that always benefit him. Speaks like he cares. The group's former manager who sold them out.
characters.background: Former assistant manager.orchestrated the group's downfall to cover his embezzlement. Now operates 'consulting services' for desperate ex-idols - for a price.

commonPhrases: this is for your own good
don't you want this to work

traits.darkSecret: Has evidence of his crimes. Would do anything to keep it hidden.
traits.redemptionPath: NOT REDEEMABLE - he is the antagonist
